@everyone
Hello to all the legendary owners!

We are opening the LAUNCHER ONLY (not the game) for download to legendary holders (of legendary vehicle, land, or dome). This allows us to test the launcher while also giving us the ability to grant game download access to those with the proper hardware specs. Game access for these new users will be granted as soon as possible after we assess and define the hardware criteria based on the results.

So right now, you should be able to visit the Cornucopias website and log in. Once logged in, you will find the download button in the top navigation (available on Windows only). After downloading, you can run it to install the desktop launcher. We hope everything goes smoothly, but if you encounter any issues, please let us know.

Following that, all those who have downloaded and run the launcher with the appropriate hardware and legendary holders will gain access to the game. This will happen in the coming days, so we appreciate your patience. We are just as excited to get this game into your hands as you are to play it.

Thanks! (edited)

@everyone

This is a friendly security reminder! Cornucopias will NEVER, under any circumstance, in this universe or the next, have a flash mint. 

What is a flash mint? A flash mint is simply an NFT sale that is advertised as "happening NOW" with no prior announcement to the community. WE WILL ALWAYS PREPARE YOU FOR NFT SALES WELL IN ADVANCE!!!

So... ask yourself this question... had this announcement been steering you toward a NFT sale that we decided to put on last second with no prior announcement would you have fallen for it OR screamed SCAM? 

Hint: SCAM is the right answer. 

Stay safe out there folks! May the corn be with you
